## Summary

Describe the proposed paper addition, metadata correction, annotation improvement, or taxonomy change.

## Evidence

Link the official paper record and any official artifacts or stable evidence used to verify the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read `docs/scope.md`, `docs/taxonomy.md`, `docs/inclusion-criteria.md`, and `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] I searched for duplicate titles, arXiv identifiers, DOIs, and superseded versions.
- [ ] Each new paper has one canonical record in `data/papers.yaml` with its complete ordered author list.
- [ ] Publication status and venue are supported by an official source.
- [ ] YAML prose values are quoted and remain on one physical line.
- [ ] Each README paper entry uses exactly five physical lines and follows the author-display rule.
- [ ] Entries are ordered newest-first and alphabetically by title within the same year.
- [ ] Artifact and community-signal links are stable, relevant, and publicly verifiable.
- [ ] `python scripts/validate.py` passes locally.
